prompt:
Use case: historical-scene.
Asset type: ONE seamless continuous panoramic exterior landscape painting, a diffuse texture for the distant view OUTSIDE the windows of a real 3D Chinese study. The attached reference supplies the precise fine Chinese gongbi and qinglü mineral-pigment art style. Do NOT render a study, room, furniture, window, scroll, tabletop, frame or any text.
Primary composition constraint: a very wide landscape canvas, aspect ratio approximately 3:1 (ideally 2304 x 768 or 2172 x 724). The TOP 55 PERCENT OF THE ENTIRE IMAGE must be extremely quiet almost blank warm ivory silk-paper sky, with just the softest nearly invisible pale grey mountain silhouettes at the lower edge of that upper zone. Preserve clear unpainted breathing room across the entire upper central two-thirds where a separate title will be overlaid later. NO high mountains, palace roofs, busy branches, clouds with hard edges, flowers, or other significant shapes intruding into that quiet upper 55%.
Keep ALL substantial landscape detail in the BOTTOM 45% and lower outer sides: layered finely drawn grey-celadon and mineral blue-green mountains at the far left and right; a muted light ochre and dusty vermilion Tang palace on the lower right, not a dominant red building; very small classic pavilions beside water, a small delicate arched bridge and garden rocks near the bottom; broad open pale misty river/lake and low-density cloud-water in the lower centre. Depth through gently fading hand-painted mountains and silk-coloured mist. Fine ink contours and subtly layered pigment on tiny buildings/rocks/trees, matching the reference's precise traditional drawing. Elegant, pale, antique, matte and luminous.
Palette: ivory and pale warm silk cover most pixels; restrained low-saturation grey-celadon, soft blue-green, muted light ochre, a little faded cinnabar and very sparse dull gold fleck. Avoid muddy grey, white studio gradients, loud orange filters, saturated turquoise or bright red.
Important exclusions: no writing, calligraphy, stamps, letters, logos or borders; no people, no characters, no figures; no foreground flowers, peonies, large blossoms, hanging branches, objects or containers; no indoor elements; no image of an entire homepage. This is ONLY one calm distant exterior art material, not the complete scene. No photography, realistic 3D render, low-poly, cartoon, flat geometric mountains or generic sparse vector art. Keep refined hand-painted silk texture and delicate gouache/gongbi detail in the lower artwork, while deliberately leaving the top half nearly blank.
composition: Continuous panoramic exterior only. Quiet almost-blank upper central 55%; detailed pale celadon mountains, mist and muted palace concentrated lower and outer sides. No indoor scene or baked title.
encoding: WebP encoding only; source PNG preserved
